title: Surgical Relevance

positions.as_written: Avoid combining a medial arthrotomy with a complete lateral release where the alternative exists, and document what was divided.
Measure patellar thickness before resection and restore the composite, rather than resecting to a target depth.
Leave the uncovered lateral facet in mind: a component that does not cover the whole cut surface leaves bone articulating with the component groove.
In a young patient with instability, prefer the procedure that preserves bone stock, because the patella cannot afford a second operation that removes more.
